goal: Allow generateblock to create coinbase transactions with multiple custom payouts
Enable callers to assemble blocks directly from the mempool without listing transactions manually
Help developers simulate mining pool payouts and complex block structures in regtest
reviewability: Ready for review as nothing currently invalidates it
agreement: Substantive support with open suggestions on interface scope
Strong support for simulating pool payouts that pay multiple recipients from coinbase (supertestnet)
Open suggestion to split making arguments optional into a preparatory PR (maflcko)
Open suggestion to require at least one output address instead of allowing an empty list (achow101)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it expands regtest mining RPC ergonomics for developers
Enables testing complex pool payout schemes like Ocean and Braidpool without external block builders
Benefit is confined to testing and simulation environments rather than mainnet node operation
